# Isaiah Chapter 61 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 158r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_061_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**61:1** The-spirit [ruach] of-the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH [is] upon-me, because YHWH has-anointed [mashach] me to-bring-good-news [levasser] to-the-afflicted [anavim]; he-has-sent-me [shelachani] to-bind-up [lachavosh] the-brokenhearted [le-nishberei-lev], to-proclaim [liqro] to-the-captives [li-shevuyim] liberty [deror] and-to-the-prisoners [la-asurim] opening [peqach-qoach] [of the prison];

**61:2** to-proclaim [liqro] the-year [shenat] of-the-LORD's-favor [ratson la-YHWH] and-the-day of-vengeance [naqam] of-our-God; to-comfort [lenachem] all who-mourn [avelim].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 61 — "The Year of the LORD's Favor" — part of Third Isaiah (chs.56-66). The post-exilic community grapples with the gap between prophetic promise and present reality.

---
## Disagreement Log

Minor register disagreements resolved through standard SOPHIA consensus process.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
